description: This file defines the ArticleActivity class for an Android app, responsible for displaying a news article when the activity is launched. It manages initialization, retrieves intent extras for category and article indices, determines if a two-pane layout is active, and loads an ArticleFragment with the specific article.

classes.name: ArticleActivity
classes.description: Android activity class for displaying a specific news article. It manages activity lifecycle events and fragment transactions to show the article content based on intent data.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity by retrieving category and article indices from the intent, checks for two-pane layout, and loads the appropriate article fragment.
